minecraft_parallax.mode.window.tooltip: Moving your head moves the view behind the screen, like looking through a real window. Turning your head does nothing.
minecraft_parallax.mode.window_and_head_: Window effect, plus turning your head turns the view (amplified, so your eyes can stay on the screen). Your aim stays where the mouse points.
minecraft_parallax.options.title: Minecraft Parallax Settings
minecraft_parallax.options.key_hint.rece: %s Recenter: your current pose becomes "straight ahead"
minecraft_parallax.options.key_hint.togg: %s Turn the effect on or off
minecraft_parallax.options.key_hint.stat: %s Show or hide the status overlay
Sit how you normally play and look at the middle of the screen, then click.
minecraft_parallax.options.controls.tool: Rebind keys (look for the Minecraft Parallax category).
minecraft_parallax.options.enabled.toolt: Master switch. Same as the toggle key.
minecraft_parallax.options.yaw_gain.tool: How much the view turns per degree you turn your head left or right.
minecraft_parallax.options.pitch_gain.to: How much the view turns per degree you tilt your head up or down.
minecraft_parallax.options.deadzone.tool: Head turns smaller than this are ignored, so the view doesn't wobble when you sit still.
minecraft_parallax.options.max_turn.tool: The furthest the view can turn away from where you are aiming.
minecraft_parallax.options.strength.tool: Amplifies head movement for the window effect. 1.0 is physically correct, 0 turns the window effect off.
minecraft_parallax.options.window_distan: How far away (in blocks) the virtual glass is. Things at this distance stay still; closer things pop out of the screen, further things sit behind it.
minecraft_parallax.options.smoothing.too: Extra smoothing. Higher is steadier but reacts later.
minecraft_parallax.options.crosshair.too: Moves the crosshair so it stays on the block you would actually hit.
Also apply the window effect in third-person views. Head look only works in first person.
minecraft_parallax.options.auto_recenter: Recenter automatically when the tracker first connects after starting the game.
minecraft_parallax.options.status_hud.to: Show tracking numbers in the top-left corner. Same as the status key.
minecraft_parallax.options.reset.tooltip: Resets the settings in this menu. Keeps your calibration (screen size, recentered position).
